title: BETA.DIST: 136 of 288, inside a 671-row battery total that is not a surface figure
status_plain: b22 is the beta-SUBSTRATE battery, not a BETA.DIST corpus: BETA.DIST is 288 of its 671 rows and the remainder are the F and T surface blocks. The per-surface BETA.DIST figure is 136 of 288; the 293 of 671 beside it is a group total across three surfaces. A second BETA.DIST corpus, b21, is a designed deep-tail discriminator battery of 127 rows on which production scores 4 -- and the same 127 rows carry an Excel-versus-truth finding that is not a pass rate at all: at k=2, a=118/200, Excel sits 41 to 63 ULP from the true value yet within 7 ULP of every Eq-9-family realization.
